{{Quote|Superb. Bring ten spiced teas to my friend Muna Skish. He's usually somewhere near the cantina.|[[Gendra]], to a trader|<ref name="SWG:C" />}}
'''Muna Skish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and worked at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Spaceport Cantina]].<ref name="SWG:C" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the cantina had a problem with its [[Spice tea/Legends|spiced tea]] distributor. In order to help the cantina owner [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], one of his friend named [[Gendra]] paid the services of a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] to make spiced tea. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] prepared ten glasses of tea and delivered them directly to Muna Skish at the cantina.<ref name="SWG:C" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muna Skish was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:C" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Muna Skish was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
